description: Run a full one-time audit of a website — AI visibility, plus security headers, broken links, performance, and a crawlability-and-markup score (`scores.seo`: robots.txt, AI crawler access, sitemap, structured data, meta description and Open Graph tags). Use this when someone asks to "audit," "scan," "check," or "review" a website's health, or wants a complete report rather than just the AI-visibility number. Returns a scored summary across categories and a link to the full report. The ranked cited-`sources` evidence behind the AI-visibility number is returned by get_ai_visibility, not by this tool. If `name_warning` is present, the business name the AI-visibility score was measured against could not be verified — relay that caveat rather than presenting the score as settled fact. Requires a Website Auditor subscription ($49/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends) — if the user doesn't have one, call get_sample_audit first to show them the exact output format, free and with no API key.

business_location.description: Optional. The city the business trades in, e.g. "Hilo, HI". Leave it out and the audit detects it; when nothing is detectable the questions widen to the country or drop the place entirely, which is right for a national or global business and wrong for a local one.

business_name.description: Optional. The business's real name, if you know it. Leave it out and the audit detects the name from the site and flags it when unverified — a guessed name is scored as if confirmed, so supply one only when it is actually known.

name: run_audit

name_warning.description: Set ONLY when the business name could not be verified, which puts the AI-visibility score in question.

recommendation_gap.description: How far behind the top beatable rival the site is, in the answers that recommend it. Present only when measured; its sentence reads the result back in one line.

answers.description: The answers this is a share of: one per question, per assistant.

gap_points.description: Points behind the top rival in the answers that RECOMMEND the site (negative when ahead). Null, never 0, when there is no rival or too few answers.

rival.description: The top BEATABLE rival: marketplaces, delivery and booking apps, directories and national chains are left out. Null when none is recommended.

sentence.description: One plain sentence to read back to the owner; also folded into summary.

state.description: Which kind of gap this is, or why there is none.

tied_with.description: Other rivals tied for the top: one gap, all named.

unclear.description: The rules could not say how the answer treated the site. Not negative.

title: Run a full audit
